tasks.title: Wire dashboard task views to generated task data
tasks.summary: Connect the visible task cards to a generated feed so refreshes show current task state.
tasks.detail: Keep a single canonical task source and avoid parallel hand-maintained views.
tasks.nextAction: Finish task generator and connect dashboard fetch path.

tasks.title: Monitor generated feed freshness
tasks.summary: Generated surfaces should stay easy to audit so stale task data is obvious.
tasks.detail: Use generated timestamps so refresh behavior is visible at a glance.
tasks.nextAction: Expose generated timestamp in the dashboard metadata path.

tasks.title: Verify generated task cards reload cleanly
tasks.summary: Functional verification depends on the generated file being in place and read with cache bypass on refresh.
tasks.detail: Browser should show the latest generated content after page reload without needing bundled fallbacks.
tasks.nextAction: Run the task generator, then reload and verify card output.

tasks.title: Prepare phase 8 owner brief
tasks.summary: Summarize the new canonical task flow and any remaining risks once the wiring is merged.
tasks.detail: Keep the brief short and focused on data flow, not implementation trivia.
tasks.nextAction: Draft after implementation and verification are complete.

tasks.title: Avoid second task source
tasks.summary: Phase 8 explicitly closes the door on duplicate task truth living in separate view payloads.
tasks.detail: Task rendering should be driven from generated data derived from the canonical source only.
tasks.nextAction: Keep future task edits in data/tasks.json.
